name: Rod of Resurrection

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

magic.attunement: by a Cleric, Druid, or Paladin

last.text: disappears in a flash of light

text: Holding the rod, you can spend its charges to cast Resurrection for 5 charges or Heal for 1. It holds 5 charges and recovers 1 each dawn. Using up the final charge means rolling 1d20: a result of 1 makes the rod vanish forever in a burst of light.
